hero.desc: We are a premier custom ironwork workshop in Miami. We fabricate custom iron doors, metal balconies, and privacy fences with bespoke design. Utilizing premium aluminum, stainless steel, and iron, we guarantee highly durable and artistic metal fabrication for luxury properties.

about.title: Meet Dario
about.desc1: Dario has over 20 years of experience. He is an expert in custom ironwork in Miami. Our workshop creates custom design pieces for exclusive residences. Every iron door, balcony, or sculpture project is true architectural art. We have transformed traditional forging into unique pieces tailored to our clients' tastes.
about.desc2: Metal is a canvas for us. We forge doors, railings, and chandeliers from scratch. Dario personally oversees every detail in the workshop. We guarantee durable artistic forging using aluminum or stainless steel. Your custom ironwork will be a lasting legacy for your property.

howTo.title: How to request your custom design

steps.title: Initial Request
steps.desc: Send us your initial measurements and reference photos via WhatsApp or our contact form. We will discuss your specific tastes and requirements to create a unique custom ironwork piece. This initial consultation helps us understand your vision for your Miami property.

steps.title: Technical Visit
steps.desc: We will conduct a thorough technical visit at your property in Miami to take exact measurements. During this visit, we help you choose the ideal premium material for your project, whether it is lightweight aluminum, stainless steel, elegant bronze, or classic wrought iron.

steps.title: Custom Fabrication
steps.desc: Our master craftsmen will forge your bespoke metal design in our local Miami workshop. We apply a highly durable electrostatic powder coating to your custom iron doors, gates, or balconies. This baked finish ensures extreme resistance against rust and harsh coastal weather.

steps.title: Safe Installation
steps.desc: Our professional team will deliver and install your custom ironwork directly at your home. We perform a safe, clean installation strictly complying with the Florida Building Code. We ensure your new iron doors or fences are perfectly secured and visually stunning.

items.q: What is custom ironwork and what does the service include?
items.a: Custom ironwork is a specialized metal fabrication process focused on artistic forging and bespoke metal design. Our exclusive service in Miami includes designing, building, and installing custom iron doors, durable balconies, metal gates, and privacy fences. Every piece is specifically tailored to match your property's unique architecture.

items.q: Does Dario's comply with the Florida Building Code (FBC) for hurricanes?
items.a: Yes, our custom ironwork strictly complies with the Florida Building Code (FBC) for hurricane protection. Our heavy-duty iron doors, gates, and metal balconies are engineered to resist extreme hurricane winds up to 175 mph. We use precise engineering and bespoke metal design to guarantee maximum safety.

items.q: What are the differences between traditional blacksmith paint and Powder Coating?
items.a: Powder coating is a highly durable protective finish baked at 400 degrees Fahrenheit, making it heavily superior to traditional blacksmith paint. This advanced process protects your custom iron doors and metal balconies against the intense Miami sun and corrosive sea salt. It guarantees your metal design will not rust.

items.q: What service areas do you cover in South Florida?
items.a: Our custom ironwork service areas cover all of Miami-Dade County and surrounding regions in South Florida. We design, fabricate, and install bespoke metal projects in Miami, Coral Gables, Doral, Brickell, Pinecrest, and Key Biscayne. We bring our premium privacy fences, balconies, and custom iron doors directly to you.

items.q: What kind of maintenance do your metal gates and grilles require?
items.a: The maintenance for our custom metal gates and iron railings is incredibly simple. You only need to wash the structure every three to six months using mild soap and water. Our premium electrostatic powder coating finish actively protects your custom ironwork, keeping your iron doors looking brand new forever.

items.q: What is the process to request a technical quote for my residence or business?
items.a: The process to request a technical quote starts by contacting us via WhatsApp or our online form. Simply send us rough measurements and photos of your space. First, we provide an estimated price for your custom design. Then, we visit your Miami home to accurately measure and forge your ironwork.
